Key Features

  • Stainless Steel Needle Teeth: Features long, durable stainless steel needles with micro-grooved or spiral dense designs to increase friction and trap the tiniest nits.

  • Scalp-Safe Design: The needles have rounded, smooth tips to prevent pricking, scratching, or pulling on the scalp and hair.

  • Ergonomic Handle: Designed with a comfortable grip, often including anti-slip bands to ensure precision and control during the combing process.

  • Ecological Solution: Provides a chemical-free, mechanical method for lice extermination, making it ideal for children, pets, and those with allergies or sensitive skin.

  • Versatile & Reusable: Suitable for all hair types (short, long, or thick) and is corrosion-resistant for easy cleaning and sterilization after use.

How to Use

  • Preparation: For best results, use on wet hair saturated with conditioner or oil to immobilize the lice and make detangling easier.

  • Sectioning: Part the hair into small sections about the width of the comb.

  • Combing: Place the comb flat against the scalp and draw it firmly from the roots to the ends of the hair.

  • Cleaning: Wipe the comb onto a white tissue or rinse it in soapy water after every stroke to remove captured lice and eggs.
